summary: Update a markup of a proposal
description:
Partial JSON merge-patch. Examples: `{ "name": "Bond" }`, `{ "value": 12.5 }`, `{ "tax_mapping": null }`.
application_criteria and compound_with replace the stored list when sent.
Legacy Overhead and Discount cannot change value_type, and a normal markup cannot become a legacy type.

parameters.name: markup_id
parameters.description: Markup Id from a markup's id on GET Estimate Summary (markups)

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

data.description: Represents a markup (adjustment) applied to a proposal.

id.description: The unique identifier of the markup. Returned by GET Estimate Summary in markups; use as markup_id on markup endpoints.

name.description: The display name of the markup.

value.description: The numeric value of the markup (percentage or lump sum amount).

value_type.description: The type of the markup value.

stage.description: The calculation stage of the markup.

compound_all.description: Whether this markup compounds with all preceding markups in the same stage.

compound_with.description: The IDs of specific markups this markup compounds with.

tax_mapping.description: The tax mapping category for this markup.

application_criteria.description: The flat list of conditions controlling which line items this markup applies to. Conditions are combined with logical AND.

items.description: A single application-criteria condition. Multiple conditions on a markup are combined with logical AND.

schema.description:
Partial markup update. Only properties with a specified
Optional`1 value are written; omitted fields stay unchanged.
Nested lists (compound_with, application_criteria) replace the stored
list when ...

name.description: The display name of the markup. Trimmed; must be unique case-insensitively on the proposal.

value.description: The numeric value of the markup (percentage or lump sum amount).

value_type.description: The type of the markup value. Cannot be changed for legacy overhead or discount.

stage.description: The calculation stage of the markup. Changing stage re-validates compounding.

compound_all.description: Whether this markup compounds with all preceding markups in the same stage.

compound_with.description: The IDs of specific markups this markup compounds with. Same-stage, prior, non-iterative only. Omit to leave unchanged.

tax_mapping.description: The tax mapping category. Null means All.

application_criteria.description: Replace-all flat AND list of include/exclude conditions. Omit to leave unchanged.

items.description: A single application-criteria condition. Multiple conditions on a markup are combined with logical AND.

operator.description: Whether this condition includes or excludes matching items.

line_item_group_id.description: Line item group IDs to match.
